text:
Leah (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands recap thread. We surfaced a few recurring themes about why we won and why we lost — can we capture the core decision drivers and top asks so GTM/Product can act? I'll start with a short summary.

Jamal (Sales): Quick summary from the field: 1) security/compliance (SOC2, KMS/HSM) 2) predictable latency & p95 SLOs 3) predictable cost for high-throughput inference. Lost FinSys mainly on SOC2/KMS gap. Won AdTech because of latency and cost per-req.

Priya (Product): Helpful. Can you list the concrete asks we should prioritize? e.g. BYOK/KMS integration, clearer SLA language, or a Dedicated->Private migration playbook?

Jamal (Sales): Priority ranking from sales: 1) BYOK/KMS 2) explicit SLA wording (per-route p95 guarantees) 3) migration playbook + checklists for procurement.

Marco (Eng): We can prototype a BYOK flow but need exact security constraints (HSM vs cloud KMS, audit events). Also the AdTech win: our caching + batching recommendations reduced their cost ~30% — worth surfacing as a play.

Ben (Data): Telemetry note: customers >50 qps are very sensitive to token-level cost variance. Recommend a "high-throughput checklist" + an example config that Sales can share. Sample snippet below for discussion:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  p95_target_ms: 250
  batching: true
```

Anna (CS): CS asks: customer-facing case studies and an "audit readiness" checklist (logs, retention, KMS proof points). Procurement teams want a one-page summary.

Sofia (Customer Success): :thumbsup: I'll draft the one-pager and pair with Sales on a procurement checklist. Need an owner for BYOK scoping.

Leah (CEO): Owners: @Sofia + @Priya to own product/ops backlog items. @Marco + @Ben to provide feasibility and rough effort estimates by EoW. Action items: create ticket for BYOK scoping, build high-throughput checklist, and a short 2-line "why we won" blurb for reps.

dev-bot: New ticket created: PROD-4512 "BYOK/KMS support - scoping" assigned to Marco. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PROD-4512

Marco (Eng): I’ll take PROD-4512. Quick clarifying Q: does the compliance ask require on-prem HSM integration or cloud KMS with customer-managed keys/network peering? @Anna any examples from FinSys?

Anna (CS): Both patterns exist. FinSys required HSM-backed key wrapping + detailed audit logs. I'll attach a redacted spec to PROD-4512.

Leah (CEO): Nice. One more ops ask from Sales: can we get a 1–2 line win explanation reps can use? Jamal, can you draft 2–3 options we can ship to the sales kit?

Jamal (Sales): On it, will post 3 one-liners by EOD.

Leah (CEO): Thanks team — please add any missing signals here and tag if you need a follow-up meeting.

Sofia (Customer Success): Adding note: also hearing asks for longer retention of debug logs for audits (30–90 days) — flagging for product.

Ben (Data): Noted. I’ll surface cost vs retention tradeoffs in the checklist.

Priya (Product): I’ll put backlog epics together and sync with Sales/CS tomorrow.

Leah (CEO): Perfect. Closing the thread — we'll review the tickets in next week's roadmap sync. :rocket:
